text:
nina_onboarding: Quick idea — propose we add a 3-step pulse after onboarding milestone 1/3/7 days to capture 3Q feedback (satisfied?, blocker?, NPS-ish). Feed responses into healthscore adjustments and auto-trigger a short playbook if negative. Thoughts?

sam_ops: I like it. Can we make the payload minimal — just a boolean happy + free text + optional rating 1-5? keeps webhook cheap.

maya_cs: +1. Need to make sure it maps to our existing healthscore buckets (healthy/at-risk/engage). How will text feed the scoring?

leo_data: We can run a tiny classifier on free text to detect intent/urgency and assign +1/-2 weights. Rating and boolean combine to a composite signal. I'll draft the mapping.

nina_onboarding: plan:
- event triggers at 24h, 72h, 7d
- payload: {"happy":bool,"rating":int(1-5),"note":string}
- store raw in onboarding_feedback table
- emit derived signal to healthscore service

sam_ops: sounds good. Can we add a backoff so we don't spam customers who already submitted?

alex_eng: Implementation notes:
```
POST /hooks/onboard_feedback
Content-Type: application/json
{ "customer_id": "C123", "milestone": "72h", "happy": true, "rating": 5, "note": "all set" }
```
We can add dedupe on (customer_id,milestone) at receiver.

maya_cs: Also require opt-out check (customers that opted out of surveys). Put that in the pipeline before sending playbook triggers.

leo_data: I'll supply the model endpoint and mapping table by EOD Tuesday. Proposed derived feature: feedback_score = rating - (negative_classifier? 2:0) - (happy?0:1)

nina_onboarding: Ops: @sam_ops will you own the webhook policy + dedupe/backoff? Data: @leo_data owns mapping. CS: @maya_cs will draft playbook actions for at-risk triggers. Eng: @alex_eng will handle endpoint and retries.

sam_ops: I can own policy. I'll add config knobs: max_per_month, skip_if_submitted, opt_out_check. Will propose in #eng-infra for rate-limiting.

alex_eng: I'll spin up a quick receiver and add tests. Can we start with a soft rollout to 10% of new onboardees?

nina_onboarding: yes 10% initial. maya — can you prepare two short playbooks: fast-touch (1d) and escalate-to-CSE (3d) for negative signals?

maya_cs: On it. I'll post playbook drafts here by tomorrow.

cs-bot: deploy-bot: created onboarding-feedback-receiver PR #432 — waiting review :eyes:

nina_onboarding: Nice. Follow-ups: leo to share mapping, sam to post webhook policy, alex to link PR, maya to attach playbooks. We'll sync Friday 10am to decide rollout date. :calendar:
